result.rationale: The diff shows `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` closes the header's `<%- if ... %>`/`<%- else %>` with `<%- end if %>` (visible verbatim in the new file). ERB compiles that to `end if` with no modifier expression on that line, i.e. invalid Ruby, so the template fails to compile at runtime and /embed/best 500s on the success path — a real, verifiable defect introduced by this diff.

judged_text: The header if/else is closed with `<%- end if %>`, which compiles to invalid Ruby (`end` followed by a condition-less `if` that then swallows the following statements and leaves the block tree unbalanced), so the template raises a SyntaxError when compiled. Every /embed/best request that finds a topic_id fails at template compile time and returns 500 instead of the embedded discussion — once the background retrieval succeeds, the comments never render for anyone; the success-path controller specs in this same diff fail on this too.
